primaryAgents.name: Cowork
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.
keyBenefits: Executes multi-step work across Microsoft 365 instead of answering one question at a time. Built for delegation: it plans, invokes skills, works across data sources, and produces deliverables with review checkpoints.

resources.title: Use Dynamics 365 Sales skills in Copilot Cowork
resources.description: Official scenarios and skill model for Dynamics 365 Sales in Cowork.

resources.title: Role Hub

resources.title: What to Use When
resources.description: Routes a request to the best-fit Copilot agent and reserves Cowork for longer multi-output work. Useful early in a role path when tool choice is still forming.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Avoid for a quick single answer when Copilot or a specialized agent is sufficient, and for work that should keep running on a schedule after you stop asking, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot and select Cowork beside Chat. Describe the outcome you want rather than a single question, then review the work at each checkpoint it presents.

primaryAgents.name: ECIF Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Surfaced through Sales Agent, ECIF Agent brings investment guidance and actions together with account and opportunity data in a single pane of glass. It also exists as a standalone agent with its own entry point, but Sales Agent is the recommended way to use it. It supports the end-to-end ECIF journey, connecting the systems used across it.
primaryAgents.whatItIs: Surfaced through Sales Agent; also available as a standalone domain agent.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Understand eligible investment offers; create compliant ECIF workscopes with guided, auto-populated inputs; identify suitable suppliers; submit requests; and track status, milestones, overdue actions, and delivery progress.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Preparing or refining an ECIF funding request; selecting an eligible offer or supplier for an Opportunity and location; submitting a request; or tracking milestones and delivery across internal or partner-led projects.
keyBenefits: Reduces seller toil by bringing ECIF guidance and actions into one conversational flow; improves workscope completeness and first-pass quality; speeds the path from scope creation to IO/PO; and provides a connected view of requests, milestones, alerts, and delivery progress.

resources.title: ECIF Guidance and Agent Reference
resources.description: Guidance for ECIF workflow, access surface, and governed review.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: ECIF investment workflow: which system, when
resources.description: The investment path across systems. Sales Agent and the ECIF Agent for guidance, ECIF Central for the workscope, MSX Deal Assistance for submission and tracking, MCAPS Help when blocked. For Azure offers, start at Azure Offer Navigator.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat the agent as the final authority for policy, eligibility, compliance, funding approval, or supplier selection. Review generated content and required evidence before submission, and use governed ECIF channels for exceptions or approvals.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Sales Agent and ask for ECIF or investment help in the chat. This keeps investment questions alongside account and opportunity data in a single pane of glass. ECIF Agent also has a standalone entry point, but you do not need to open it separately.

primaryAgents.name: MSXI Assist V2
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Assistance within MSXI for certified-report analysis, report discovery, KPI definitions and supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Analyze certified MSXI data to investigate performance, pipeline or consumption signals; find relevant reports, understand KPI definitions and take supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you need to analyze an enabled certified MSXI report, investigate its signals, find the right report or understand a metric before deciding what action to take.
keyBenefits: Combines certified-report analysis with natural-language report discovery and KPI explanations, helping users investigate signals, inspect source evidence, apply supported report actions and identify where further validation is needed.

resources.title: MSXI Report and KPI Help
resources.description: MSXI report discovery and KPI interpretation support.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Proactive Insights is distinct: use its lightbulb entry point to subscribe to topic or report summaries; use the Assist robot entry point for questions and certified-report analysis. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. For Proactive Insights, select the light bulb icon on the same page, then choose a topic, detail level and sending preference to subscribe to emailed snapshots. No enrollment is required.

primaryAgents.name: Auto-Fix Pipeline Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agent in MSX intended to resolve supported pipeline hygiene issues.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Supports targeted pipeline cleanup inside MSX.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When a Practice explicitly addresses supported pipeline hygiene correction.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.name: MSXI Assist V2
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Assistance within MSXI for certified-report analysis, report discovery, KPI definitions and supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Analyze certified MSXI data to investigate performance, pipeline or consumption signals; find relevant reports, understand KPI definitions and take supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you need to analyze an enabled certified MSXI report, investigate its signals, find the right report or understand a metric before deciding what action to take.
keyBenefits: Combines certified-report analysis with natural-language report discovery and KPI explanations, helping users investigate signals, inspect source evidence, apply supported report actions and identify where further validation is needed.

resources.title: MSXI Report and KPI Help
resources.description: MSXI report discovery and KPI interpretation support.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Proactive Insights is distinct: use its lightbulb entry point to subscribe to topic or report summaries; use the Assist robot entry point for questions and certified-report analysis. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. For Proactive Insights, select the light bulb icon on the same page, then choose a topic, detail level and sending preference to subscribe to emailed snapshots. No enrollment is required.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

resources.title: MSXI Report and KPI Help

secondaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Proactive Insights is distinct: use its lightbulb entry point to subscribe to topic or report summaries; use the Assist robot entry point for questions and certified-report analysis. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. For Proactive Insights, select the light bulb icon on the same page, then choose a topic, detail level and sending preference to subscribe to emailed snapshots. No enrollment is required.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use as a substitute for a specialized agent when the work requires a specific system or workflow, for a multi-step task you would rather hand off and review, which is Cowork, or for work that should keep running on a schedule, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot from the app launcher or copilot.cloud.microsoft and start in Chat.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: ECIF Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Surfaced through Sales Agent, ECIF Agent brings investment guidance and actions together with account and opportunity data in a single pane of glass. It also exists as a standalone agent with its own entry point, but Sales Agent is the recommended way to use it. It supports the end-to-end ECIF journey, connecting the systems used across it.
primaryAgents.whatItIs: Surfaced through Sales Agent; also available as a standalone domain agent.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Understand eligible investment offers; create compliant ECIF workscopes with guided, auto-populated inputs; identify suitable suppliers; submit requests; and track status, milestones, overdue actions, and delivery progress.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Preparing or refining an ECIF funding request; selecting an eligible offer or supplier for an Opportunity and location; submitting a request; or tracking milestones and delivery across internal or partner-led projects.
keyBenefits: Reduces seller toil by bringing ECIF guidance and actions into one conversational flow; improves workscope completeness and first-pass quality; speeds the path from scope creation to IO/PO; and provides a connected view of requests, milestones, alerts, and delivery progress.

resources.title: ECIF Guidance and Agent Reference
resources.description: Guidance for ECIF workflow, access surface, and governed review.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: ECIF investment workflow: which system, when
resources.description: The investment path across systems. Sales Agent and the ECIF Agent for guidance, ECIF Central for the workscope, MSX Deal Assistance for submission and tracking, MCAPS Help when blocked. For Azure offers, start at Azure Offer Navigator.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat the agent as the final authority for policy, eligibility, compliance, funding approval, or supplier selection. Review generated content and required evidence before submission, and use governed ECIF channels for exceptions or approvals.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Sales Agent and ask for ECIF or investment help in the chat. This keeps investment questions alongside account and opportunity data in a single pane of glass. ECIF Agent also has a standalone entry point, but you do not need to open it separately.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Analyze certified MSXI data to investigate performance, pipeline or consumption signals; find relevant reports, understand KPI definitions and take supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you need to analyze an enabled certified MSXI report, investigate its signals, find the right report or understand a metric before deciding what action to take.
keyBenefits: Combines certified-report analysis with natural-language report discovery and KPI explanations, helping users investigate signals, inspect source evidence, apply supported report actions and identify where further validation is needed.

resources.title: MSXI Report and KPI Help
resources.description: MSXI report discovery and KPI interpretation support.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Proactive Insights is distinct: use its lightbulb entry point to subscribe to topic or report summaries; use the Assist robot entry point for questions and certified-report analysis. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. For Proactive Insights, select the light bulb icon on the same page, then choose a topic, detail level and sending preference to subscribe to emailed snapshots. No enrollment is required.

primaryAgents.name: Cowork
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.

primaryAgents.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
primaryAgents.shortDescription: AI assistant across Microsoft 365 apps and work data.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Draft, summarize, analyze, prepare, and create within familiar Microsoft 365 experiences.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Everyday work grounded in emails, meetings, chats, files and app content, in the app you are already working in. Ask and get: you want the answer or the draft now.
keyBenefits: Reduces time spent drafting, summarizing, and preparing work; uses permitted Microsoft 365 context to keep work grounded.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use as a substitute for a specialized agent when the work requires a specific system or workflow, for a multi-step task you would rather hand off and review, which is Cowork, or for work that should keep running on a schedule, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot from the app launcher or copilot.cloud.microsoft and start in Chat.

primaryAgents.name: Researcher
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Deep research agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot that produces structured, source-cited reports.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Combines work content and web research across multiple steps.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Customer, market, competitor, industry, and strategic research requiring citations. Researcher is also reachable inside Sales Agent, which uses it to answer research questions; call Researcher directly when you want the full sourced report rather than an answer inside a sales conversation.
keyBenefits: Produces source-cited research reports rather than unattributed summaries, combining work content and web research across multiple steps so claims can be traced.

resources.title: Get started with Researcher in Microsoft Copilot
resources.description: Official guidance for complex, multistep research across the web and permitted work data, including clarifying questions, structured source-cited reports, and prompting guidance.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Avoid for quick summaries or lightweight drafting.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot and select the Researcher agent, then state the research question and sources.

secondaryAgents.name: GitHub Copilot
secondaryAgents.shortDescription: AI coding assistant available in an IDE, GitHub Copilot CLI, and the GitHub Copilot app. Repository or working-folder context supports code and configuration work rather than acting as a CRM source of record.
secondaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Write, explain, refactor and test code; scaffold infrastructure-as-code and deployment artifacts; build the smallest spike that proves or disproves an architecture assumption; generate sample data and validation scripts; and reproduce a reported failure so you can see it rather than describe it.
secondaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the next step is to build something rather than to plan or describe it. Validating an architecture assumption with a spike, standing up a demo or workshop environment, iterating a proof of concept, reproducing a deployment or integration failure, or packaging a reusable asset with tests and setup steps.
keyBenefits: Creates reviewable code and test evidence to validate an architecture assumption or reproduce a failure, giving technical and account teams a more concrete basis for the next decision. Human review and testing remain required.

resources.title: GitHub Copilot documentation
resources.description: Official GitHub Copilot documentation hub: getting started, IDE/CLI/app quickstarts, and core concepts.

resources.title: Where to use GitHub Copilot
resources.description: Choosing where to work with Copilot: IDE, CLI, GitHub.com, and the Copilot app, mapped to the stage of work.

resources.title: Best practices for using GitHub Copilot
resources.description: Official guidance on Copilot's strengths and limits, and choosing inline suggestions versus Copilot Chat for a given task.

resources.title: Adopting GitHub Copilot in your enterprise
resources.description: Governance and rollout guidance for adopting Copilot at scale: plans, policies, and codebase standards. Useful when the huddle conversation turns to customer-facing adoption or governance questions.

secondaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for customer, market or account research; that is Researcher. Do not use it to assemble a customer-facing document or deck; that is Cowork. Do not point it at production without the review your team already requires, and do not paste customer data into it. It works on code and configuration, not on the CRM record.
stepsToGetStarted: Choose the Copilot extension in your IDE, GitHub Copilot CLI for terminal work, or the GitHub Copilot app for coordinating agent-driven development. Open or select the relevant repository or working folder so the task has context. Start with: Explain what this deployment does, then write the smallest test that would prove the assumption I am least sure about. Review proposed commands and edits, run the relevant tests, and follow your approved environment and data-handling rules.

primaryAgents.shortDescription: Surfaced through Sales Agent, ECIF Agent brings investment guidance and actions together with account and opportunity data in a single pane of glass. It also exists as a standalone agent with its own entry point, but Sales Agent is the recommended way to use it. It supports the end-to-end ECIF journey, connecting the systems used across it.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.title: Sales Agent Capabilities Guide
resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

secondaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Write, explain, refactor and test code; scaffold infrastructure-as-code and deployment artifacts; build the smallest spike that proves or disproves an architecture assumption; generate sample data and validation scripts; and reproduce a reported failure so you can see it rather than describe it.
secondaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the next step is to build something rather than to plan or describe it. Validating an architecture assumption with a spike, standing up a demo or workshop environment, iterating a proof of concept, reproducing a deployment or integration failure, or packaging a reusable asset with tests and setup steps.
keyBenefits: Creates reviewable code and test evidence to validate an architecture assumption or reproduce a failure, giving technical and account teams a more concrete basis for the next decision. Human review and testing remain required.

secondaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for customer, market or account research; that is Researcher. Do not use it to assemble a customer-facing document or deck; that is Cowork. Do not point it at production without the review your team already requires, and do not paste customer data into it. It works on code and configuration, not on the CRM record.
stepsToGetStarted: Choose the Copilot extension in your IDE, GitHub Copilot CLI for terminal work, or the GitHub Copilot app for coordinating agent-driven development. Open or select the relevant repository or working folder so the task has context. Start with: Explain what this deployment does, then write the smallest test that would prove the assumption I am least sure about. Review proposed commands and edits, run the relevant tests, and follow your approved environment and data-handling rules.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

resources.description: Detailed reference for Sales Agent components, capabilities, and example prompts.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

resources.title: Use Sales Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
resources.description: Official overview and use guidance for Sales Agent.

resources.title: Sales Agent on mobile
resources.description: Announcement and prompt starters for Sales Agent on mobile, available through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and in Teams and Outlook. Covers pre-meeting account summaries, fast pipeline lookups, and updating MSX from the field behind a confirmation card. Current as of August 2026.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not treat Deal Agent as a separate agent to select; it is a skill inside Sales Chat. Do not rely on it alone for complex negotiations or sensitive disclosures, and do not bypass the legal approval chain for material amendments. Do not treat a first response as final on a complex deal; re-run and verify against current data. Do not use it for work outside the CRM such as decks, emails, and documents; that is Cowork. When it offers a confirmation card before creating or changing an MSX record, read what it is about to write rather than confirming by reflex - nothing is committed until you tap, and that tap is the only check on it.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams or Outlook, or install the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on your phone. Use the agent picker to find and select Sales; no separate install is required. Start a new chat with a deal prompt such as: List my upcoming renewals this quarter. Deal Agent triggers automatically. Keep one chat thread per deal so the context stays clean. On mobile, name the account or opportunity explicitly - Sales Agent is sharpest when pointed at a specific record. MCAPS Help is built in, so you can also ask how to complete an MSX task.

primaryAgents.name: MSXI Assist V2
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Assistance within MSXI for certified-report analysis, report discovery, KPI definitions and supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Analyze certified MSXI data to investigate performance, pipeline or consumption signals; find relevant reports, understand KPI definitions and take supported report actions.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you need to analyze an enabled certified MSXI report, investigate its signals, find the right report or understand a metric before deciding what action to take.
keyBenefits: Combines certified-report analysis with natural-language report discovery and KPI explanations, helping users investigate signals, inspect source evidence, apply supported report actions and identify where further validation is needed.

resources.title: MSXI Report and KPI Help
resources.description: MSXI report discovery and KPI interpretation support.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Proactive Insights is distinct: use its lightbulb entry point to subscribe to topic or report summaries; use the Assist robot entry point for questions and certified-report analysis. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. For Proactive Insights, select the light bulb icon on the same page, then choose a topic, detail level and sending preference to subscribe to emailed snapshots. No enrollment is required.

primaryAgents.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
primaryAgents.shortDescription: AI assistant across Microsoft 365 apps and work data.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Draft, summarize, analyze, prepare, and create within familiar Microsoft 365 experiences.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Everyday work grounded in emails, meetings, chats, files and app content, in the app you are already working in. Ask and get: you want the answer or the draft now.
keyBenefits: Reduces time spent drafting, summarizing, and preparing work; uses permitted Microsoft 365 context to keep work grounded.

resources.title: Role Hub
resources.description: Always-available hub for role guidance and enablement.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use as a substitute for a specialized agent when the work requires a specific system or workflow, for a multi-step task you would rather hand off and review, which is Cowork, or for work that should keep running on a schedule, which is Scout.
stepsToGetStarted: Open Microsoft 365 Copilot from the app launcher or copilot.cloud.microsoft and start in Chat.

primaryAgents.shortDescription: Agentic Microsoft 365 experience for longer-running, outcome-focused, multi-source work.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Plans and executes multistep work, invokes skills, and creates deliverables with checkpoints.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When you want to hand off a multi-step piece of work and review it rather than do it. Complex tasks spanning Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 data, documents, presentations and recommendations, where it plans the work, runs the steps and checks in before it finishes.
keyBenefits: Executes multi-step work across Microsoft 365 instead of answering one question at a time. Built for delegation: it plans, invokes skills, works across data sources, and produces deliverables with review checkpoints.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.

keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ

primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: MSXI Assist V2 and the experience formerly called MSXI Copilot are the same Copilot experience inside MSXI, not two tools or a pending product merge. Do not imply that Assist retrieves information outside authorized MSXI data or is a general analytics tool for arbitrary datasets. Point participants to the experience the activity actually names.
stepsToGetStarted: Opens the MSXI home page. For the Assist copilot, select the robot icon in the top ribbon (tooltip "MSXI Assist") to open the sidecar. primaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

secondaryAgents.name: Sales Agent
secondaryAgents.shortDescription: Conversational sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, reached through the agent picker as Sales, on desktop and on mobile through the Microsoft 365 Copilot app as well as in Teams and Outlook. Deal Agent runs as a skill inside Sales Chat and triggers automatically when you ask about a renewal or a deal.
secondaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Search, synthesize, and act on sales data, and support repeatable execution-focused sales workflows. Through the Deal Agent skill it also runs enterprise renewals end to end: deal discovery and history, Deal Book generation, EA quotes and proposals, amendments, pre-approvals, and licensing questions, traversing more than a dozen source systems from a natural language prompt.
secondaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Account, opportunity, pipeline, meeting preparation, CRM updates, and configured sales actions. Also on mobile immediately before or after a customer meeting: account summaries, pipeline and usage health, decision makers on an opportunity, list price lookups, and updating MSX in the moment by creating an opportunity, changing a close date or adding a forecast comment. For renewals and deals, ask about enrollments, renewal agreements, agreement summaries, license estate, Azure consumption against commitment, Deal Books, EA quotes, proposals, amendments, and pre-approvals. EA and MCA-E renewals are the primary motion. Lead with an identifier such as a TPID, agreement number, or enrollment number; specific prompts return real deal data and vague prompts return generic answers.
keyBenefits: Brings permitted sales data and supported record actions into the flow of work, including on mobile. Deal Agent can assemble renewal facts and Deal Books from supported source systems; verify freshness, completeness, and current scenario availability. Review each proposed MSX write and your authority before confirming it.

primaryAgents.name: Scout
primaryAgents.shortDescription: Always-on agent that runs on your desktop. You set it up once and leave it running: it works to a schedule without being asked, remembers what it saw last time, and can reach work that sits outside Microsoft 365.
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Recurring checks, follow-up nudges and work that reaches outside Microsoft 365. Watch a book of accounts for movement between reviews, catch commitments going quiet, notice a signal approaching its expiry, and carry what it found last week into this week rather than starting from nothing.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: When the work should keep running after you stop asking. Set it up and leave it running for anything recurring, anything that needs watching between reviews, and anything that reaches outside Microsoft 365. The test is whether you want an answer now or want to be told when something changes.
keyBenefits: Keeps work moving between sessions rather than inside one chat. Monitors signals, coordinates follow-through, and prepares materials within organizational controls.

resources.title: Microsoft Scout FAQ
resources.description: What Scout is, what it can do across files, browser, shell and Microsoft 365, and how autonomous and scheduled work behaves.

resources.title: MCAPS Lobster Pound community
resources.description: Seller community sharing working Scout patterns, including account planning, customer language mining and recurring monitoring.

primaryAgents.whenNotToUseIt: Do not use it for a quick single answer that Copilot would handle in the app you are already in, and do not use it for a multi-step task you want done once and handed back, which is Cowork. It sees the same Microsoft 365 content under the same permissions as the others, so reaching for it does not get you more access. Do not use it to bypass a human checkpoint because it can run unattended; anything it produces while running on its own still needs the same review.
stepsToGetStarted: Go to aka.ms/m, the internal Scout hub. Request the access package, complete the agreement, download and install Scout, then sign in with Microsoft 365 and GitHub as instructed. Start with a business outcome rather than a tool command.

primaryAgents.name: Sales Home
primaryAgents.shortDescription: The seller landing surface inside Sales Agent, opened from Microsoft 365 Copilot. It brings your alerts and quota attainment, your prospecting signals and your pipeline into one place, and answers questions against what MSX holds. It is in preview for SME&C sellers on MSX and is enabled for individual contributors, not managers.
primaryAgents.whatItIs: SME&C Seller surface within Sales Agent
primaryAgents.whatItHelpsYouDo: Pull the real state of an opportunity out of MSX and read it back plainly: the current stage and when it last moved, the recorded next step and who owns it, the close date and what supports it, and any blocker or objection captured against the account. It works across your whole book, so you can ask which opportunities in your solution area have a named competitor recorded, which partners keep letting co-sell records lapse, or which accounts already carry a discount or non-standard term. It also drafts first-touch outreach to contacts that already exist in MSX, in English.
primaryAgents.whenToUseIt: Use it when the question is what is on the record. Deal preparation, pressure-testing a close date, working your prospecting signals, checking the concessions already in force on an account before you negotiate, or finding the other opportunities where this same objection has already come up. Reach for it first whenever you would otherwise open MSX and click through an opportunity by hand. If Sales Home has not been turned on for you, Sales Accelerator covers the same prospecting and signal work and is where your queue lives. Sales Agent is the wider conversational surface that Sales Home sits inside, so if you are already in a Sales Agent chat you do not need to switch.
keyBenefits: Replaces the click-through: stage, next step, owner, close date and open objection come back in one answer instead of four screens in MSX. Because it reads across your whole book at once, questions that used to mean opening opportunities one at a time, such as where a competitor has shown up, which partners keep lapsing, or what you have already conceded on an account, become a single prompt. Most usefully, it shows you where the record is empty, which is normally the thing costing you the deal.
